app.welcomeHint: Type a message below to start chatting with Pi, or select a session from the sidebar.

dialog.title: Before you start
dialog.intro: A few things to set up before you start. Permission mode starts as Ask.
dialog.projectsBody: A chat that starts without a project is saved in a dated folder here. The default is a folder named SPOPI in your home directory.
dialog.modelBody: Add a model if this is your first time with Pi. If you already use the Pi terminal, your models and keys are already set up.
dialog.checkLater: The check did not finish. See Settings → Dependencies.
dialog.toolsReady: npm and the browser are ready. Test all in Settings → Dependencies checks the rest.
dialog.packagesBody: Install them from Settings → Packages → Recommended. They add per-turn review and undo, diagnostics, subagents, and worktrees. Installing needs npm.
dialog.npmRequiredBody: Pi installs packages with npm, and it is not working on this computer.
dialog.browserMissing: Pi's development browser needs Chrome. Download it from Dependencies.
